extracted.name: Easy Corn Salsa
extracted.description: This corn salsa recipe is a fresh, easy summer appetizer! I like to make it with raw corn for crunch. You could also grill the corn to add smoky, charred flavor. Both versions are delicious!
ingredient_lines: 2 cups fresh corn kernels (from about 3 ears of corn)
¼ cup diced red bell pepper
½ teaspoon sea salt (plus more to taste)
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, combine the corn, onion, cilantro, bell pepper, lime juice, garlic, jalapeño, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Chill until ready to use. Serve with chips for dipping or scoop onto tacos, burgers, or salads!
